root_cause.first_trigger: EventSource 'error' on GET /bff/events/stream (liveSse.ts handleError) called refreshBffSession. Fixture SSE responses end after one chunk, so the stream errors right after open.
root_cause.refresh_response_in_fixture: Loopback fixtures do not stub POST /bff/auth/refresh. Contained auth aborts undeclared /bff/** (network error); 17-a11y catch-all '**/*' returns 200, producing a refresh -> reconnect -> stream end -> refresh loop (617 refresh POSTs in one test).
root_cause.why_logout: refreshBffSession treated any non-ok/network failure as session expiry (clearSessionExpiry + reportBffUnauthorized confirmed:true) -> /auth.

fix: sessionExpiry.ts: only refresh 401/403 starts the session-expired flow; 404/5xx/network/timeout return false without clearing session (all callers: transport, proactive, visibility, SSE); removed confirmOnlyOnAuthStatus option.
liveSse.ts: a drop after the stream had opened is a transient disconnect -> backoff reconnect, no refresh probe; refresh only when the stream failed before ever opening.
f12_approval_hosted: F12 authenticated approval owner readback @approval-hosted ALSO FAILED on 1a6438fa9 (the pre-#899 commit; run 41570098230 job 125700724000), so it is not caused by PR #899 and is not fixed here. It requires a hosted BFF and is not runnable locally.

verification.playwright: e2e/02-control-room, 17-a11y-v5, 18-perf on chromium: 15 passed, 2 skipped (pre-existing), no assertions changed
